events.title: Tupac Shakur's Passing
events.blurb: Commemorating 30 years since the tragic passing of influential rapper Tupac Shakur in Las Vegas.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: Thirty years ago today, we lost a true icon. Remembering the undeniable impact of Tupac Shakur on music and culture. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Jimi Hendrix's Passing
events.blurb: Remembering the legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix, who passed away on this day 56 years ago.

angles.name: Jimi's Influence
angles.copy: Still influencing guitarists worldwide, we remember the unparalleled talent of Jimi Hendrix, who left us far too soon on this day in 1970.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic 'Abbey Road' album on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Iconic
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago today, The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road' – a masterpiece with one of the most famous album covers ever. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, the iconic frontwoman of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde – still fronting The Pretenders with that unmistakable attitude.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Liam Gallagher, the distinctive voice of Oasis, celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Liam
angles.copy: Our kid is 54! Happy Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher, still bringing the swagger and the tunes.

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's timeless anthem 'Imagine' was released on this day in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine's Message
angles.copy: More than just a song, John Lennon's 'Imagine' was released on this day in 1975. Its message of peace and unity still resonates globally.

events.title: First iPod Released
events.blurb: Apple launched its revolutionary first-generation iPod on this day in 2001.

angles.name: iPod Nostalgia
angles.copy: Remember the click wheel? On this day in 2001, Apple introduced the world to the original iPod, changing how we listened to music forever.

events.title: Global James Bond Day
events.blurb: Celebrating Global James Bond Day, marking the premiere of 'Dr. No' in 1962.

angles.name: Favourite Bond
angles.copy: It's Global James Bond Day! From the gadgets to the theme tunes, who's your favourite Bond and what's their best moment?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon's Enduring Genius
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we celebrate the enduring genius and indelible mark John Lennon left on music and the world.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the comedy genius John Cleese. From Python to Fawlty Towers, a true British institution.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Masterpiece
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago, The Beatles unleashed 'The White Album' – a sprawling, experimental masterpiece that still sparks debate and adoration. What's your standout track?

events.title: Freddie Mercury's Passing
events.blurb: Commemorating the passing of Queen's iconic frontman, Freddie Mercury, 35 years ago.

angles.name: Freddie's Unmatched Legacy
angles.copy: Thirty-five years ago, we lost a legend. Remembering the one and only Freddie Mercury, whose voice and stage presence remain unmatched.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Influence
angles.copy: A pivotal moment in pop music history: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' was released on this day in 1965, showcasing a new depth and artistry.

events.title: John Lennon's Passing
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who was tragically killed on this day 46 years ago.

angles.name: Lennon's Lasting Impact
angles.copy: Forty-six years ago today, the world lost a visionary. We remember John Lennon and his profound legacy in music and beyond.
